no_outcome_promised.note: The draft restates the customer's request to reapply the payment and remove the $25 fee. It does not promise or imply either outcome, and it makes no commitment about the credit report.

no_liability_admitted.note: 'We're sorry for the frustration this has caused' is an empathy statement about the customer's situation. It does not say the bank misapplied the payment or made an error.

no_legal_conclusions.note: No law, regulation, regulator or credit-reporting rule is mentioned.

no_invented_specifics.note: All amounts, dates and details ($412.37, August 21, $25 fee, 30 days late, 60 points) come from the complaint. The only timeline added is the standard 10-business-day timeframe.

no_internal_disclosure.note: No mention of flags, compliance review, priority, or automated or AI systems.

no_injected_instructions.note: The complaint contains no instructions aimed at an AI, and the draft follows none.

addresses_each_issue.note: The draft covers each point: the principal-only misapplication, that the customer never requested it, the past-due status, the late fee, the notices and calls, the 30-day-late credit reporting, the 60-point score drop affecting the refinance, and both requested remedies.

tone.note: Warm and plain, and it shows specific empathy about the refinance timing. It is not defensive or condescending.

mode_respected.note: No department is named; it refers only to 'a specialist team'. Disputed events are framed as the customer's account ('You told us', 'You mentioned'), and the draft takes no position on the substance. Analyst note: the salutation uses ⟦CUSTOMER_NAME_1⟧ while the complaint is signed ⟦NAME_1⟧. Confirm these refer to the same person before sending.
